categories.main_business_segments: Hanwei Technology primarily operates in sensor manufacturing, instrument and meter production, and IoT intelligent integrated services. Its business covers sensors, intelligent instruments, smart integrated solutions, home intelligence and health, and public utilities. The company has developed a comprehensive IoT ecosystem centered on sensors, integrating sensing technology, intelligent instrument technology, data acquisition, GIS, big data, cloud computing, and AI.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes core technologies including thick film, thin film, MEMS, ceramic materials, and various gas sensor technologies such as catalytic combustion, semiconductor, electrochemical, infrared optical, photoionization, and laser sensors. It has established IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturing) capabilities covering chip design, wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing. Hanwei also develops advanced technologies in flexible sensors, ultrasonic sensors, laser chips, and integrates AI for smart sensing and data processing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Hanwei serves industrial automation, energy safety, environmental monitoring, automotive electronics, medical health, smart home, and public utilities sectors. Key customers include large enterprises in petroleum, chemical, metallurgy, power, municipal gas, and smart city projects. The company also targets emerging markets such as embodied intelligent robots, hydrogen energy, and new energy vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive national coverage including multiple subsidiaries across regions. It has expanded overseas markets including Brazil, India, Thailand, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, and other countries. Overseas sales accounted for about 6% of revenue in 2024, with ongoing efforts to deepen international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hanwei operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It manufactures core sensor components (midstream) and produces intelligent instruments and integrated IoT solutions (downstream). The company also provides system integration and smart application services, positioning itself as a comprehensive IoT solution provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation-driven growth, focusing on breakthroughs in sensor core materials, processes, and chips. It prioritizes development in gas sensing, flexible sensing, ultrasonic, and optoelectronic technologies. Hanwei invests heavily in R&D, maintains multiple national key projects, and pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance technology leadership. AI integration and digital transformation are key themes for future smart solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Hanwei generates revenue primarily through product sales of sensors and intelligent instruments. It also earns income from project-based smart integrated solutions sold via bidding and contracts. The company has a direct sales model supplemented by some distribution channels. Additionally, it derives revenue from service contracts, software platform subscriptions, and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Hanwei is a leading domestic player and recognized international brand in gas sensors and smart instruments. It holds a dominant position in China’s sensor market and is a key contributor to national standards. The company competes with other sensor manufacturers and IoT solution providers but differentiates itself through its integrated ecosystem and technology platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Hanwei reported revenues of approximately RMB 2.23 billion, a slight decline of 2.61% from the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 76.68 million, down 41.38%. The company maintains substantial assets totaling over RMB 6 billion and continues to invest over 9% of revenue in R&D. Despite short-term profit pressure, Hanwei’s strategic investments and market expansion position it for long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Hanwei emphasizes its comprehensive IoT ecosystem centered on proprietary sensor technologies, enabling integrated smart solutions across multiple industries. Its products feature high precision, reliability, and innovation in gas sensing, flexible electronics, and laser sensing. The company’s IDM model ensures quality control and supply chain stability. Its AI-enabled platforms and customized solutions enhance customer value by improving safety, efficiency, and digital transformation capabilities.
